business_summary: Aichi Steel Corporation manufactures and sells steel materials, forged products, electronic functional materials and components, and magnetic products in Japan, the United States, Thailand, China, and internationally. The company operates through Steel Company, Stainless Steel Company, Forge Company, Smart Company, and Others segments. It offers specialty steel products, including carbon and alloy steel for machine structural use, H-shaped steel for structural use, alloy steel bolting materials for high temperature service, microalloyed and boron steel, and spring and high carbon chrome bearing steel; hot and cold work tool steel; stainless steel products, such as angle and unequal angle bars, channel and wide channel bars, flat and square bars, compression bars, welded H-beams and T-bars, round bars, stainless steel bars for concrete reinforcement, and custom welded shaped steel, as well as stainless steel products for high-pressure hydrogen, blades, building structures, and water sluices. The company also provides titanium round, angle, and flat bars; forged products, including engine, chassis, transmission, driveline, and e-axle units; ultra-sensitive magnetic/MI sensors, MAGFIT dental magnetic attachments, and MAGFINE bonded magnets; amorphous wires; electronic materials and components, including lead frames, bonding pads, and heat spreaders; and TetsuRiki Agri/Aqua iron fertilizers for crops. In addition, the company is involved in the production of flame retardant materials and forging dies; design and installation of industrial furnaces; mining, processing, and sale of limestone and other minerals; cargo transportation, handling, and storage; software development; and sale and maintenance of computers and accessories. Further, it engages in the sale of daily commodities; and provision of restaurant, lunch catering, and gardening services, etc. Aichi Steel Corporation was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Tokai, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Aichi Steel Corporation은 일본, 미국, 태국, 중국 및 해외에서 철강 재료, 단조 제품, 전자 기능 재료 및 부품, 자기 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 Steel Company, 스테인레스 스틸 회사, Forge Company, Smart Company 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 기계 구조용 탄소 및 합금강, 구조용 H형강, 고온 서비스용 합금강 볼트 체결 재료, 미세합금강 및 붕소강, 스프링 및 고탄소 크롬 베어링강을 포함한 특수강 제품을 제공합니다. 열간 및 냉간 가공 공구강; 앵글 및 부등각 바, 채널 및 와이드 채널 바, 플랫 및 사각 바, 압축 바, 용접된 H-빔 및 T-바, 라운드 바, 콘크리트 보강용 스테인레스 스틸 바, 맞춤형 용접 성형 강철과 같은 스테인레스 스틸 제품뿐만 아니라 고압 수소, 블레이드, 건축 구조물 및 수문용 스테인레스 스틸 제품. 이 회사는 또한 티타늄 원형, 앵글 및 플랫 바를 제공합니다. 엔진, 섀시, 변속기, 드라이브라인 및 e-액슬 장치를 포함한 단조 제품; 초민감 자기/MI 센서, MAGFIT
